title: Reported speech: backshift and say/tell
rule: L'inglese sposta i tempi di un passo indietro quando il verbo principale è al passato (said, told, asked, explained). Present simple → past simple (I'm tired → she said she was tired). Present continuous → past continuous. Present perfect → past perfect. Past simple → past perfect (spesso) o resta. Will → would. Going to → was / were going to. Can → could, may → might, must → had to. Could, would, should, might restano. Se il verbo principale è presente (she says) o la verità è ancora vera (water boils at 100°C), nessun backshift. Spostamenti di tempo e luogo: here → there; now → then; today → that day; tomorrow → the next day; yesterday → the day before; this → that; last week → the week before. Say vs tell: say non prende oggetto (she said that…), tell lo richiede (she told me that…). Say + to + oggetto + discorso diretto (she said to me «hi»); tell + oggetto + to + infinito per un ordine (she told me to go). Gli italiani sbagliano spesso con will → would, con said me (dovrebbe essere told me) e con la dimenticanza del backshift complessivo.

items.t: «I'm here now.» → She said she was there then.
items.n: «Sono qui adesso.» → Ha detto che era lì allora.

items.t: «I bought the ticket yesterday.» → She said she had bought the ticket the day before.
items.n: «Ho comprato il biglietto ieri.» → Ha detto che aveva comprato il biglietto il giorno prima.

items.t: «Call me tomorrow!» → He told me to call him the next day.
items.n: «Chiamami domani!» → Mi ha detto di chiamarlo il giorno dopo.

items.t: «Water boils at 100°C.» → The teacher said water boils at 100°C. (verità universale: nessun backshift)
items.n: «L'acqua bolle a 100°C.» → L'insegnante ha detto che l'acqua bolle a 100°C.

blocks.title: Il discorso indiretto italiano
blocks.text: Il backshift inglese corrisponde all'italiano: present simple → imperfetto; present perfect / past simple → trapassato prossimo; will → condizionale passato; going to → stava per / sarebbe andato a; can → poteva. L'errore italiano tipico: lasciare will al posto di would (he said he will come): sbagliato. L'italiano può anche sbagliare con said me invece di told me: in inglese say non prende oggetto.

items.why: Will → would obbligatorio dopo verbo principale al passato.

items.wrong: She said me that she was leaving.
items.right: She told me that she was leaving.
items.why: Say non prende oggetto; tell sì.

items.wrong: He told that he was tired.
items.right: He said that he was tired. / He told me that he was tired.
items.why: Tell richiede un oggetto; say no.

items.q: «I'm tired» → She ___ she ___ tired. «I'll come» → He ___ he ___ come. «I've seen it» → She ___ she ___ seen it.
She ___ (say / tell) me the truth. He ___ (say / tell) that he was late. She ___ (say / tell) her kids a story.
She said she would call me the next day.
answers: She said she would call me the next day
She said she'd call me the next day
